_readme: Level 2's quieter town (T32): where its small plaza cast spend their day, plus Rosa's walk from her stall to the office conference room.
Positions are world metres in Office_Level2 (its plaza and office are the same as Office_Level1's). yaw: the way a person faces (degrees, 0 = +Z).

residents: model = index into Resources/Levels/Level_02/scene_assets.asset residentModels; id = the person's id in Levels/Level_02/plaza_life.json (their name and talks); idle = a state of Assets/AssetIntegration/NpcHumanoid.controller; activity Stand, Patrol (looping route), or Visit (the shared Level 1 guard's ordered social round). partnerId/leadsChat set an optional pair. The MarketVisit customer walks to visitSpot and leaves when Rosa is spoken to.
A seat point is on the seat surface under the pelvis, yaw away from the backrest (the same rule as Level 1's seat markers). height = the model is fitted to this many metres.

rosa: route points are walked in order (doorways crossed straight through): toReception, then after waiting receptionWaitSeconds at the front desk, toRoom; her room spot is the case's clientFinale.spotPath. leaveDelaySeconds = the beat after Mark the Money! begins before she sets off.
Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the game.

residents._who: Mang Ernesto, retired market bookkeeper, reading on the bench between the plaza and the office forecourt (Level 1's west seat marker; nobody sits there in Level 2). Seated, so he never blocks a route.
Tess, a young mother on her errands, strolling slowly round the quiet north-east corner of the plaza, away from Rosa's stall and the office doors.
Arthur strolls the plaza on a relaxed loop, carrying the briefcase and offering optional local conversation; the Level 2 route does not use his Level 1 guide or corkboard duties.
Mang Dante, the familiar office security guard from Level 1, starts on the forecourt and visits Level 2's available plaza people in a short ordered round.
Marie chats with Mang Ernesto by the bench; both remain optional and independently interactable.
A customer walking toward Rosa during the Market Visit. The customer waits with her until Elijah starts talking to Rosa, then walks back to the plaza edge.
